spotlight.three instructors to know.

01 / 03
spotlight 01qualified jan 2026
mat instructor, manchester14 classes a week

jess qualified in january and now teaches fourteen mat classes a week. her rule: plan for twenty, then teach the room that actually turns up.

45 minute mat, standing to floor. no props, so late arrivals can join without stopping the room.

two gyms in manchester. weekday mornings and evenings.

spotlight 02qualified mar 2026
mat instructor, dubaicover list to her own slot

aisha spent six weeks on a studio's cover list, said yes to every early slot, and had her own 7am class by week seven.

30 minute sunrise mat. breath, then spine, then a slow burn through the hips.

a boutique studio in jumeirah. weekdays at 7am, with a waiting list.

spotlight 03qualified 2025
mat instructor, londonsold out since june

priya couldn't find a studio slot in london, so she hired a community hall. twenty mats, one speaker and a waiting list since june.

50 minute mat on a hall floor, with cues that carry without a mic.

a community hall in hackney. thursday evenings and sunday mornings.
